name: KKH 98 (Hubble)
blurb: KKH 98, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: kkh98-hubble
story: Hubble resolved this small, nearby dwarf galaxy into thousands of individual stars. Read together, they tell of a galaxy that has kept up a relatively constant, low-level trickle of star formation over much of cosmic time.

claims.text: KKH 98 is a nearby dwarf irregular galaxy
Hubble images resolve thousands of its stars
It has had relatively constant low-level star formation over much of cosmic time
Observed by the ACS Nearby Galaxy Survey
